The dead were being made into a file while they were still being made. Then came
The twenty-first of May, 1917: a royal charter, and the {{x|Imperial War Graves Commission}}, with its duties

To the graves of the empire's dead in that war, and their care after, and the names of the missing,
Not for a season: the charter said the care was to last. The {{c|3373|Prince of Wales}} was president; {{c|4316|Ware}}, vice-chairman.
{{c|4317|Frederic Kenyon}}, director of the {{x|British Museum}}, was asked, on the twentieth of November, to bring
The marking to a rule, and he put equality at its centre: the same stone, for the private and the man

Of rank, and no private monument as the rule. He signed his report on the twenty-fourth of January, 1918;
The commission had it in February; it was published in November. The architects named were
{{c|4318|Edwin Lutyens}}, {{c|4319|Herbert Baker}} and {{c|4320|Reginald Blomfield}}. The stones were mostly still unseen,
But the rule was written. {{c|4321|Rudyard Kipling}} gave the sentence for a body with no name, to stir

Over the unknown: Known unto God. His own son, {{c|4322|John Kipling}}, had been missing since the twenty-seventh
Of September, 1915, at {{p|Loos}}. It was the {{p|British Empire}}'s rule for its own dead, a decision, not a discovery;
In May of 1920 the families' quarrel with it reached {{x|Parliament}}: many wanted, under heaven,
Their own dead home, or a stone of their own choosing; the commission held to the ground, and the one form, the delivery

Of permanence. And the stopping was also a decision, and timed. In a railway carriage in the forest of {{p|Compiègne}},
Before dawn on the eleventh of November, 1918, the armistice was signed:
{{c|4323|Ferdinand Foch}} for the {{c|4324|Allies}}, {{c|4325|Matthias Erzberger}} at the head of the {{c|2669|Germans}}; and the terms ran
That the operations on land and in the air would cease six hours after, by the clock; and the government, assigned

To tell {{x|Parliament}}, said that day it was signed at five in the morning, and the war ceased at eleven.
The hour was appointed. Until it, orders still ran on both sides of a line that had a clock and no peace yet.
{{c|4326|Princip}} fired; {{c|4327|Sophie}} died with the heir; the declarations were signed on later days, and given,
By other men; and the end was given too, by an hour, as a debt

Is paid at an hour. The register had begun years before, because the ground was not keeping what it was given;
{{c|4316|Ware}}'s file is the refusal to let the next advance be the erasure: count the named; cut the same stone for the private and the rank;
Keep the missing as missing, which is a kind of name. And keep the day both ways: the grief, for the millions driven
Into the ground, and the joy, for the guns gone quiet at eleven, the bells, the crowds, the thanks.

The eleventh hour of the eleventh day: a mourning and a feast at once, kept as one.
Known unto God is a sentence for a body, kept over the field where the body lay.
The day keeps the hour they appointed, and the names the hour did not give back to anyone,
And the living who came home, and danced, and lived, and are ancestors today.


# Chapter 312: The Old Style

{{p|Russia}} kept an older count of the days.
The count this book keeps was already the one in use to the west.
In 1917 the two stood thirteen days apart.

On the eighth of March, in {{p|St. Petersburg}},
The city was called {{p|Petrograd}}.
By the calendar the country kept, it was the twenty-third of February.
Women came out. On that calendar it was {{x|International Women's Day}}.
They came for bread. The garrison came over.
{{c|4328|Nicholas II}} was not in the city.

On the fifteenth of March, at {{p|Pskov}},
The country dated the day the second of March.
He abdicated for himself and for his son {{c|4329|Alexei}},
And he named his brother {{c|4330|Michael Alexandrovich}} to the crown.
On the sixteenth, {{c|4331|Michael}} refused it,
Unless a constituent assembly, still to be elected, should confer it.
The crown was offered. It was not taken.
The reign ended on that refusal.

A provisional government sat in the capital.
{{c|4332|Georgy Lvov}} was at the head of it, and then {{c|4333|Alexander Kerensky}}.
It kept the country in the war.
The summer did not take the country out.
The government did not last the autumn.

On the sixteenth of April, {{c|4334|Vladimir Lenin}} arrived in {{p|Petrograd}}.
The country dated the day the third of April.
{{p|Germany}} had let him cross in a sealed train.
It wanted {{p|Russia}} out of the war.
The permission is not the authorship of the night that came after.
The next day he read the theses that bear April's name.
No support for the provisional government.
Power to the soviets.
An end to the war.

On the seventh of November the party took the city.
The country dated the night the twenty-fifth of October.
The revolution kept October for its name.
{{c|4335|Kerensky}} had gone.
The cruiser {{x|Aurora}}, lying in the river, fired a blank as a signal.
The {{p|Winter Palace}} was taken.
A congress of soviets sat at the {{p|Smolny Institute}}.
It passed a decree on peace, and a decree on land.
A council of people's commissars was named, with {{c|4336|Lenin}} at its head.
That night is not the civil war.
The civil war came after, and the dead of it were not few.

In November the country elected a constituent assembly.
The {{c|4337|Socialist Revolutionaries}} returned the most deputies.
The {{c|4338|Bolsheviks}} did not.
On the eighteenth of January, 1918, the assembly met
At the {{p|Tauride Palace}} in {{p|Petrograd}}.
The country dated the day the fifth of January.
It sat once.
On the nineteenth, the sixth of January in the country's count,
The sitting was closed.
The votes had been counted. The assembly was not let go on.

Early that year the government decreed
The church apart from the state and the school;
A quarrel in one house: the party's creed
Took the altar's offices, and the rule
Of the dead and the bells; and then the worst:
Priests shot, the churches closed, the flock dispersed.

On the sixth of February, in this book's count,
The same government ordered a change of days.
Its decree, in the old count, was dated the twenty-fourth of January.
The day after the thirty-first of January
Was to be called the fourteenth of February.
Thirteen date-names were never used.
After that night the state's days and this book's days are one register.
October remained the name.
In the register that remained, the night is the seventh of November.

On the third of March, at {{p|Brest}}, then called {{x|Brest-Litovsk}},
{{p|Russia}} signed itself out of the war,
And signed away a wide territory in the west.
That exit is what {{p|Germany}} had wanted from the train.
The treaty records the want.
It does not make the night a foreign order.

In March the government left {{p|Petrograd}} for {{p|Moscow}}.

The people of the house were still alive.
In the night of the sixteenth of July, crossing into the seventeenth,
At the {{p|Ipatiev House}} in {{p|Yekaterinburg}}, they were killed.
{{c|4328|Nicholas II}}. {{c|4339|Alexandra}}.
{{c|4340|Olga}}. {{c|4341|Tatiana}}. {{c|4342|Maria}}. {{c|4343|Anastasia}}. {{c|4329|Alexei}}.
Four who served them were killed in the same room:
{{c|4344|Eugene Botkin}}, {{c|4345|Anna Demidova}}, {{c|4346|Alexei Trupp}}, {{c|4347|Ivan Kharitonov}}.
{{c|4348|Yakov Yurovsky}}, commandant of the house,
Read an order of the {{p|Ural}} soviet.
A written order from {{p|Moscow}}, dated before the shooting, has not been found.
On the eighteenth, {{c|4349|Yakov Sverdlov}} told the central executive committee
That its presidium approved what the {{p|Urals}} had done.
On the nineteenth the paper said the former emperor had been shot,
And that his family had been taken to a safe place.
The children were already dead.

The books used that winter say the state is a class's machine,
And that after the class has won, the machine will wither.
The withering is not what the winter did.
The party took the ministries and kept them.
It closed the assembly the country had just elected.
It dropped the calendar and kept the old name of the day.

Hold both numbers for the one night.
The country called it the twenty-fifth of October.
This book calls it the seventh of November.
Say which count you are in.
Do not let the name October stand in for the date.
The reign ended in March, when a brother would not take a crown.
The people of the house were killed in July,
And the paper hid the children.
Keep the names. Keep the day the register you chose actually holds.
A theory is not a calendar.
A state that has been taken has not withered.


# Chapter 313: The Caliph of the Muslims

On the third of March, 1924, in {{p|Ankara}},
The {{x|Grand National Assembly}} deposed the caliph
And abolished the office.
The law said the office was already contained
In the meaning of the government and the republic.
The sentence is the assembly's. It is not a verse.

The prophet died at {{p|Medina}}.
The revelation does not contain this statute.
After the death the community gave its answers,
And the answers were more than one.
The house of {{c|3241|Osman}} carried one of them.
The name was caliph, a successor.
The law of 1924 is a state's answer to that name.
It does not erase the question.

On the first of November, 1922, the same assembly
Abolished the sultanate.
It kept the caliphate, and kept it in the house,
To be given to the one most fit in learning and character.
It did not say that {{c|4350|Mehmed VI}} had been elected to it.
On the third of November, a Friday,
He went out to the prayer under both names,
{{c|4351|Sultan}} and caliph.
On the sixteenth the assembly decided to charge him
With treason against the homeland.
That night, the sixteenth into the seventeenth,
He left {{p|Istanbul}} on a {{x|British}} warship.

On the nineteenth of November the assembly elected
{{c|4352|Abdülmecid II}}.
He painted. One of the canvases is {{c|4353|Beethoven}} in the palace.
The assembly did not give him the old title,
Commander of the faithful.
It gave him caliph of the {{c|2764|Muslims}}.
He asked to be called also servant of the two sanctuaries.
He did not hold {{p|Mecca}}. He did not hold {{p|Medina}}.
He asked to wear the turban of {{c|4354|Mehmed the Conqueror}}.
{{c|4355|Mustafa Kemal}} answered that a frock coat would do.
Later he signed in the manner of a sultan's son.
The signature was heard as the reign, trying to return.

On the twenty-fourth of November, at {{p|Topkapı}},
In the room where the prophet's cloak was kept,
The allegiance was given.
The prayer that day was in {{x|Turkish}}.
At the {{p|Fatih Mosque}} a sermon was read in {{x|Turkish}},
In the new caliph's name.
It took the sentence about the greater struggle
And read the struggle as the one against ignorance.

From the twenty-first to the twenty-seventh of December,
A caliphate conference in {{p|India}} accepted him.
On the third of January, 1923,
{{x|Indian}} {{c|2764|Muslims}} gave {{c|4355|Mustafa Kemal}} a title:
Saviour of the caliphate.

On the twenty-ninth of October the assembly proclaimed the republic
And elected him president.
The caliph stayed in {{p|Istanbul}}.
An office without the state sat in the old capital.
The state without that office sat in {{p|Ankara}}.

On the fifth of December the papers printed a letter
To the prime minister, {{c|4356|İsmet Pasha}},
From {{c|3099|Aga Khan}} and from {{c|4357|Amir Ali}}.
It asked that the office be kept,
And that the caliph's standing be given back.
On the night of the eighth the assembly, sitting in closed session,
Decided to send an independence tribunal to {{p|Istanbul}}.

On the third of March the bill was brought by
{{c|4358|Saffet Efendi}}, deputy for {{p|Urfa}}, and fifty-three with him.
{{c|4359|Seyyid Bey}}, the minister of justice,
Had taught the law of the religion, and had studied at {{p|al-Azhar}}.
He told the chamber the caliphate was not a creed.
It was a worldly question, among the public affairs of the people.
{{c|4360|Zeki Bey}}, the deputy from {{p|Gümüşhane}}, spoke against the closing.
The article passed.
The president approved the law the same day.
It was numbered four hundred and thirty-one.

The same day the assembly closed the ministry
Of religious affairs and pious foundations,
And set up a presidency of religious affairs,
Charged with the faith and the worship.
The schools were brought under one ministry of education.
The universal name came down.
A bureau of the nation stood up in its hour.

That night he was taken by car to {{p|Çatalca}}.
The next evening he boarded the train.
With him were his son {{c|4361|Ömer Faruk}},
His daughter {{c|4362|Dürrüşehvar}},
Two of the women of the house,
And the tutor, the secretary, and the doctor.
An envelope from the governor held two thousand pounds
And visas that let them out.
They had wired a hotel at {{p|Territet}}, on the lake, in {{p|Switzerland}}.
The house was banned from living in the republic.

On the eleventh of March he answered.
He said the assembly's decision was void.
He asked for a religious council,
And for help to revive the office.
Within the week {{p|Switzerland}} told him
The {{x|Turkish}} government had objected,
And that he would not be permitted the work.

In that same March, {{c|4363|Hussein ibn Ali}},
{{c|4364|King of the Hejaz}}, who held {{p|Mecca}},
Was proclaimed caliph.
The day of it is not one day in the records.
The proclamation did not reopen the office {{p|Ankara}} had closed.
Holding a sanctuary is not the succession.

He died in {{p|Paris}} on the twenty-third of August, 1944,
While the city was being taken back.
{{c|4362|Dürrüşehvar}} came and was given a promise.
The body was not brought.
On the thirtieth of March, 1954, he was buried at al-Baqi,
In {{p|Medina}}.
The grave is in the prophet's city.
The grave is not the office.

Do not say the republic contained the caliphate
Because the statute said contained.
The statute closed an office this assembly had filled,
And had titled with the lesser name.
Do not say the train refutes the religion.
A painter was put into the office, and then put on a train.
The person is not the argument.
Do not say the bureau for worship is the succession.
It is a state keeping the rites it will administer.
Hold that keeping.
Refuse the consolation that a closed office was never an office.
Refuse the consolation that a grave in {{p|Medina}} restores one.

The question of who succeeds is older than this law.
The community has given more than one answer.
This answer is a vote and a signature, on a Monday in {{p|Ankara}}.
The man they called saviour of the caliphate signed the paper that ended it.
The man they called caliph of the {{c|2764|Muslims}} died without the name.
Count the office closed on the day the law says.
Keep the question. It was not in the statute.


# Chapter 314: Finite Means

On the twenty-third of June, 1912, {{c|4193|Alan Turing}} was born in {{p|London}}.
He was a fellow of {{p|King's College}}, in {{p|Cambridge}}.
The work of this chapter was done there.

{{c|4365|David Hilbert}} had asked a question of method.
Is there a definite procedure which, given a statement of the logic,
Answers yes or no: this statement has a proof, or it has none.
The procedure would have to work for every statement.
A cleverness that sometimes arrives is not the thing he asked for.

{{c|4195|Turing}} defined a number a machine can write.
A computable number, he said, is a real number
Whose decimals are calculable by finite means.
The means are a table.
The table is finite.
The tape it works on is a strip of squares.
The machine sees one square.
It is in one of a finite list of conditions.
The table says, for that condition and that symbol,
What to write, which way to step, and which condition comes next.
He called the thing a computing machine.
The name that uses his own name is later.

The machines can be listed.
The real numbers cannot.
A list of procedures does not cover the line.
The numbers that come up in the ordinary work of calculation
Are on the list.
The line is larger than the work.

One machine can be given the table of another,
Written out on the tape,
And can then do what that other machine does.
He built, on paper, a machine for machines.
The universal one does not know the work in advance.
It knows how to follow a table.
The table is the work.

The {{x|London Mathematical Society}} received the paper
On the twenty-eighth of May, 1936.
He was twenty-three.
The paper's own line says it was read on the twelfth of November.
It is called On computable numbers,
With an application to the decision problem.
The first part was issued on the thirtieth of November.
The rest was issued on the twenty-third of December.
Both parts are of that year.
A correction was printed in the next volume.
He had not handed them a flawless text.

{{c|4366|Alonzo Church}}, at {{p|Princeton}},
Had already set down another definition.
Effective calculability, he called it.
It is not a tape.
In the spring of 1936 he had reached the same refusal:
There is no general procedure for the decision problem.
{{c|4367|Max Newman}}, at {{p|Cambridge}}, had seen {{c|4368|Church}}'s paper.
{{c|4195|Turing}} wrote an appendix.
The appendix says the two definitions meet.
He did not pretend the limit was his private finding.

What he showed is that {{c|4369|Hilbert}}'s question has no such procedure.
No machine takes every statement and returns the verdict.
He also showed a nearer limit, about the machines themselves.
Some of them go on writing digits.
Some do not.
No machine, given an arbitrary table,
Says in every case which future that table has.
A procedure can be written for a world of questions
And still not be a procedure for its own future.

In September he went to {{p|Princeton}}.
The printed paper names him at the {{p|Graduate College}} there.
The naming is the place he had reached.
It is not the place where the table was made.

In 1931 {{c|4370|Kurt Gödel}} had shown
That a system strong enough to hold ordinary arithmetic
Contains true sentences it cannot prove.
That is a limit inside one set of rules.
{{c|4195|Turing}}'s limit is about the method itself.
It asks whether any method exists that will always answer.
The two limits are not the same fact.
Do not fold them into one darkness.

Do not call this paper by the name of the halting problem.
That name is a later cleaning of a related fact.
The 1936 paper asks what a finite means can write,
And whether a finite means can decide the logic.
The answer to the second is no.

A calendar is a finite means.
It keeps a name on a day, by a rule a person can follow.
The keeping is a procedure, and the procedure can be run.
It does not, by being runnable, decide every question about the names.
Some questions have a method.
Some questions can be asked in the language of the method
And still have no method that settles them all.
Count what the table writes.
Keep the questions the table cannot close.
Say which is the procedure and which is the question.
Do not pretend the sky was running the tape before you wrote the table.


# Chapter 315: A Hand and a Name

On the nineteenth of August, 1953, in {{p|Jerusalem}},
The {{x|Knesset}} passed a law.
It established an authority of remembrance
And named the authority with two words from {{c|2181|Isaiah}}.
A hand and a name.
The verse had been spoken to the childless:
A memorial and a name, better than sons and daughters,
A name that would not be cut off.
The law took the words for the murdered.
It did not say the verse had been kept.
The law's title sets the {{x|Shoah}}, the catastrophe,
Beside the heroism.
The halls were not yet the charge.
The charge was the statute.

The law's first article is the six million
Of the {{x|Jewish}} people murdered
By the {{c|4371|Nazis}} and those who helped them.
It names also the households, the communities,
The houses of prayer, the schools,
The institutions of mercy,
Destroyed in a plan to blot out the name of {{p|Israel}}
From under the sky.
The statute says six million.
The names are kept in {{x|Yad Vashem}}'s book of names,
And this faith takes them into its ancestor days, every one.

The killing was a procedure
Before any memorial had a statute.

On the twenty-second of June, 1941,
{{p|Germany}} invaded the {{p|Soviet Union}}.
In the territory taken that summer,
{{c|2500|Jews}} were shot beside the towns.
On the twenty-ninth and the thirtieth of September,
At {{p|Babyn Yar}}, the ravine at {{p|Kyiv}},
The {{c|2500|Jews}} who had been gathered there were shot.
A ravine is a place and two days.
It is not an explanation.

On the thirty-first of July, {{c|4372|Hermann Göring}}
Charged {{c|4373|Reinhard Heydrich}}
To prepare what they called the final solution
Of the {{x|Jewish}} question in {{p|Europe}}.
An order to prepare is not the first grave.
The shootings were already underway.

On the twentieth of January, 1942,
At {{p|Wannsee}}, in {{p|Berlin}},
{{c|4374|Heydrich}} sat with the officials of the ministries.
The minutes count eleven million {{c|2500|Jews}} in {{p|Europe}}
As the people the plan named.
That count is the plan's.
It is not the number of the dead.
Do not give the murder to the meeting.
The meeting arranged the offices.
The killing did not wait for the minutes.

At {{p|Oświęcim}} the camp was called {{p|Auschwitz}}.
There a number was put on the body.
The number is not a name.
On the seventeenth of January, 1945,
The last roll call of that camp's system
Counted sixty-seven thousand and twelve.
In the days after, about fifty-six thousand were marched out.
On the twenty-seventh the {{x|Red Army}} entered
And found about seven thousand still there.
The people on the roads were not freed by the gate.
Do not give the end of the killing
To the day an army arrived.

The same law names a further charge.
Those who were not {{c|2500|Jews}},
And who risked their lives to keep a {{c|2510|Jew}} from being taken.
It calls them the righteous among the nations.
In that year the law did not judge the cases.
The judging came later, one person at a time,
On the word of the person who lived.
If the one who lived is gone, and left no word,
The register may not hold the rescuer.
The rescue is not thereby cancelled.
A life kept is a particular act
On a particular day.
It is not a proof the century came through.

The deputies of {{x|Herut}} did not cast a vote.
The bill passed.
The house then stood for five minutes.

Hold the name.
A name in the authority's care is a register
Set against an erasure that was also a register:
Lists for trains, numbers on bodies,
Minutes that counted a people as a plan.
The later list does not make the earlier list just.
It does not return a body.
It does not try the offices.
Take this consolation, for a scripture owes one:
The murdered are kept by name among the ancestors of this faith,
And the righteous who hid them are kept beside them,
And the verse is fulfilled in the keeping, not in the authority that borrowed its words.
The striving that can be named is the particular hand
That kept a person alive,
And the labor, afterward, of setting a name
Where a procedure had set a number.
The law can order the labor.
It cannot order the death undone.

Count the authority from the day the {{x|Knesset}} gives.
Keep the question the statute cannot close.
Who was killed, by name.
Who lived, and by what particular refusal.
This chapter has the dates.
The names are the work the law ordered,
And they are not finished here.


# Chapter 316: The Covenant of Peace

Proclaim a dawn that crowns the world with light,
The chains of hate lie shattered in the dust.
The crowds arise, and labor claims its right,
From forge and field their hopeful banners thrust.

Yet scarlet suns twice scorched the mourning earth,
Their silent fire wrote horror on the sky;
But hope endured where ash replaced the sand,
And swore that war’s last ember here would die.

At {{p|Hiroshima}}, August's sixth was clear;
At eight fifteen {{x|Enola Gay}} flew by;
With Tibbets at the helm, the bomb fell near:
A sun of uranium filled the sky.

The offices that kept the city's names
Were in the fire, the paper and the ink;
Seventy thousand died within the flames,
And twice that many by the year's last brink.

Out in the desert one test came before,
But no test of a city, only sand;
A notice told {{p|Japan}} to end the war;
Unanswered when the fire came on the land.

On August's eighth the Soviets made war;
Their armies crossed {{p|Manchuria}} at dawn;
{{p|Kokura}}'s aim lay under cloud's grey floor;
The plane passed over, dropped not, and went on.

On {{p|Nagasaki}} at eleven-two,
With Sweeney flying, plutonium fell,
Off its mark, over {{p|Urakami}}'s view;
The hills held back the blast, but not the knell.

Koreans brought to both the cities died,
Tens of thousands, burned beneath the same fire;
The hibakusha, touched, lived on beside;
Each named; no sum shall serve as their pyre.

Call not {{p|Kokura}}'s cloud a judgment sent,
Nor {{p|Hiroshima}}'s morning, clear and bright;
A list was made; the sky kept no intent;
Say which the city, and which hour, which light.

A crackling voice on August’s fervent air
Confessed defeat across the empire’s seas;
In {{p|Times Square}} strangers, dazzled, found a dare,
And sealed a vow with one unbridled squeeze.

The second of September set its fate;
Steel decks became the altar of release.
The working world inhaled and sealed its fate,
Proclaiming labor’s covenant of peace.

From {{p|Pittsburgh}} mills to {{p|London}}’s river docks,
The union drums beat loud in molten halls;
Red banners rolled like quick-forged iron shocks,
And bosses felt the tremor in their walls.

{{x|Kartik}} lamps glowed through {{p|India}}’s dark night,
A widow smiled, her children at her side;
As sparks like comets chased the ghosts to flight,
And whispered freedom swelling in the tide.

In ruined fields the {{x|Shintō}} harvest bowed,
White grains were heaped before a broken shrine;
The farmer wept yet offered thanks aloud,
For seeds of hope still quickened in the brine.

In {{p|Nuremberg}} the gavel cracked like doom,
The plague of hate was named before the earth;
Twelve shadows waited judgment in the room,
And heard mankind demand their curse’s birth.

December’s pilgrims gathered on the sand,
Indian scholar singing promised land;
Trader from {{p|Malay}} knelt upon the sand,
Their voices mingled, binding sand to land.

Eight fragile lights renewed a {{p|Warsaw}} room,
The youngest played where once the shadows lay;
Their mother sang against remembered gloom,
And turned the night to promise with her pray.

In ruined towns the bells returned to life,
Their silver peals stitched silence into song;
Young soldiers danced beside a wooden fife,
And swore no tyrant’s reign would last as long.

In {{p|Seoul}} the crowds lit torches in the street,
Their flags proclaimed the empire’s yoke was done;
Yet lines were drawn where foreign soldiers meet,
And dawn arose upon a severed sun.

Across the plains of {{p|China}} drums of peace
Replaced the clash of empire’s hungry blade;
Yet rival banners gathered, never ceased,
And thunder warned of storms that had not fled.

In {{p|Tokyo}} the courtroom lights burned slow,
Two years of witness weighed each mortal crime;
Yet on the throne a sacred ember glowed,
And judgment blurred along the edge of time.

On {{x|New Year}}'s day I set down my decree:
"Not akitsumikami," then a wink;
Still arahitogami, plain to see;
Nothing has changed, whatever you may think.

So ended war and dawned the workers’ dream,
With lamps and bells and grains beneath the sky;
The plague of hate dissolved like distant steam,
And human hands began to build on high.


# Chapter 317: The Plugs and the Point

On the tenth of December, 1945, at the {{p|Moore School}} in {{p|Philadelphia}},
A room of tubes was put to work.
The room had been built for the path of a shell.
The work of that December was a study brought from {{p|Los Alamos}},
Of a further weapon, which had not been made.
{{c|4378|John von Neumann}} brought the study.
The cities of August were already behind the calendar.
Do not make the room into the bomb.
The bomb had already been a city.
Do not make the study into the reason the room existed.
The contract was a table of firing.

The contract was signed on the fifth of June, 1943.
The {{x|Army}}'s laboratory at {{p|Aberdeen}} wanted the tables.
{{c|4379|Herman Goldstine}} brought the money and watched the work.
{{c|4380|John Mauchly}} and {{c|4381|J. Presper Eckert}} designed the machine.
They called the work {{x|Project PX}}.
A person who calculated for a living was called a computer.
The machine took the name of that work.
{{x|Electronic Numerical Integrator}} and Computer.
The letters are {{x|ENIAC}}.
The name does not say what the December work was.

It did not hold its own instructions.
A problem was set with plugs and with switches.
It kept its numbers in tens.
To map a problem onto the panels took weeks.
To set the cables took days.
The setting was the work.
A program stored in the machine is a later form.
It is not this room.
In 1936 a limit had been written about finite means.
This room is one such means.
It is not that paper.

Six of the computers were set to the machine.
{{c|4382|Kay McNulty}}.
{{c|4383|Jean Jennings}}.
{{c|4384|Betty Snyder}}.
{{c|4385|Marlyn Wescoff}}.
{{c|4386|Frances Bilas}}.
{{c|4387|Ruth Lichterman}}.
{{c|4388|Goldstine}} called them operators.
The designation given the women was subprofessional.
The men with the same mathematics were called professionals.

On the evening of the fourteenth of February, 1946,
They showed the machine.
{{c|4384|Betty Snyder}} and {{c|4383|Jean Jennings}} had set the demonstration.
It was the path of a shell.
A person at a desk would have taken weeks.
{{c|4379|Herman Goldstine}} and {{c|4389|Adele Goldstine}} were credited for it.
The next day the machine was dedicated.
The dinner did not invite the six.
The press called the room a giant brain.
A room of tubes is not a brain.
Tubes failed.
The room stopped until the failed one was found.

Do not call it the first.
In {{p|England}} {{c|4390|Tommy Flowers}} had already set a machine of tubes
To one purpose, and the purpose was kept secret.
In {{p|Berlin}}, {{c|4391|Konrad Zuse}} had already run a sequence
On a machine of relays.
The bombing destroyed that machine in 1943.
In {{p|Ames}}, {{c|4392|John Atanasoff}} and {{c|4393|Clifford Berry}}
Had started a machine of tubes.
The work was stopped in 1942.
This was the one they showed.

On the twenty-ninth of July, 1947, they turned it on at {{p|Aberdeen}}.
The proving ground was the place the tables had been for.
At eleven forty-five in the night, on the second of October, 1955,
It was turned off.
The move did not change the kind of work.
A table for a gun is a table for a gun.

On the sixteenth of December, 1947, at {{p|Murray Hill}},
{{c|4394|John Bardeen}} and {{c|4395|Walter Brattain}} made a small thing work.
Two gold points touched a slab of germanium.
A small change at one point steered a larger current at the other.
They had not yet named it.
{{c|4396|William Shockley}} was the head of their group.
He was not the hand on the point that day.
On the twenty-third they showed it to the laboratory.
He called the demonstration a magnificent {{x|Christmas}} present.
Early in 1948 he worked out a different device,
A layer between two layers, which could be made to a pattern.
That device was not the object in the December room.

Before the announcement, the laboratory chose a name.
{{c|4397|John Pierce}} offered the word.
They called it a transistor.
On the thirtieth of June, 1948, in {{p|New York}}, they told the press.
The device of that December was delicate.
Do not move the later device back into the {{x|Christmas}} demonstration.

A tube is a finite means.
A point on a crystal is a finite means.
Either can fail.
Either can be set to a path, or to a study, or to a voice on a line.
The setting is not the machine's verdict.
Do not make the shell's table into a judgment.
Do not make the switch into a mind.
The press had a phrase for the room.
The phrase was not a description.
Count the days.
Keep the six names the dinner left out.
Say what the contract was.
Say what the December work was.
The two are different facts.
Say which afternoon the point worked.
Say which year the name existed.
The machine did not choose the cities.
The crystal did not choose its use.


# Chapter 318: The Same Footing

On the fifteenth of December, 1945, in {{p|Tokyo}},
The headquarters of the supreme commander
Sent a memorandum to the imperial government.
Its number was 448.
Its subject was the abolition of the state's
Sponsorship, support, perpetuation, control, and dissemination
Of {{x|State Shinto}}.
The sponsorship by the national government,
By the prefectures, and by the towns,
And by any official acting as an official,
Was to cease at once.
Public money was to cease at once.
A gift that a person gave, and gave freely,
Could still be received.
The ground of a park might still be kept by the city.
The shrine standing on it was to take nothing
From the public purse.
An official was not to go, in his office,
To report that he had taken the post,
Or to stand at a rite as the government.
He could go as a man.
The order forbade militarist teaching
In the rites of {{x|Shinto}} and in the rites of every other religion,
The same prohibition, the same hour.
Its stated aim was to separate religion from the state
And to set every religion on the same legal footing.
It did not order a shrine closed.
It did not order a building pulled down.

On the twenty-eighth of December
An ordinance opened a corporation
To the sects, the temples, and the churches.
A shrine was not yet named in it.

On the first of January, 1946,
The newspapers printed a rescript of the emperor {{c|4377|Hirohito}}.
Its title was the construction of a new {{p|Japan}}.
What people called it was the declaration
That he was human.
It was not the recorded voice of the fifteenth of August.
It began by taking up the five clauses
Of the {{x|Charter Oath}} {{c|4398|Meiji}} had proclaimed.
Then it said the tie between him and the people
Had always stood on mutual trust and affection.
It did not depend on mere legends and myths.
The {{x|English}} that went with the rescript
Says the tie is not predicated on a false conception:
That the emperor is divine,
And that the {{x|Japanese}} are superior to other races
And fated to rule the world.
The rescript's own word is akitsumikami,
A manifest kami.
The {{x|English}} says divine.
They are not the same word.
The sentence refuses a conception of the bond.
It does not say what a shrine may still hold,
And it does not delete the stories.

On the twenty-third of January three bodies,
Which had been private already,
The institute for the imperial classics,
The great association of the rites,
And the association for the service of the grand shrine,
Declared they would form one association
Under the inner shrine at {{p|Ise}},
Which they looked to as the source,
For the shrines of the country,
To carry the shrines' own charge
And to contribute to the construction of a new {{p|Japan}}.
The rescript had used that aim in its title.
The declaration used it as the work.

The office that had held the shrines for the state
Was the {{x|Jingiin}}, set inside the {{x|Home Ministry}}
In November of 1940.
The memorandum had required the separation.
The end was first set for the last day of January.
On the second of February the office was ended,
And the shrines on the register
Were deemed religious corporations.
On the third of February the association was established.
Its name was {{x|Jinja Honchō}},
The main office of the shrines.
The shrines that came under it
Were a religious corporation's shrines,
Not a ministry's.
Not every shrine came under it.
{{p|Yasukuni}} was deemed a religious corporation
In its own right, and is not written here as theirs.
{{p|Ise}} was the source they named.
It was not a hall the office owned.

Do not say the memorandum ended the kami.
It ended a budget and an official attendance.
Do not say the {{x|English}} word divine
Is the whole of the word he used.
Do not say the new office was the ministry, renamed.
A voluntary gift is not a tax.
A rite without the government's representative
Is still a rite.
Hold that.
The stories are not what the rescript rested the bond on.
The stories are not thereby made nothing.
The separation was a loss. The shrines lost the state that kept them,
And an office looking to {{p|Ise}} has not restored the state that paid.
The striving is to restore it:
A religion the state keeps, established, under the source it still names.
The law can order the purse to stop.
It cannot order the visit, made as a person, to be nothing.

Count the memorandum on the fifteenth of December.
Count the rescript on the first of January.
Count the office on the third of February.
The kami are not an article in any of the three.


# Chapter 319: None Against

On the twenty-sixth of June, 1945, in {{p|San Francisco}},
The charter was signed.
Fifty governments signed it that day.
{{p|Poland}} was not in the room.
It signed in October, and it is counted among those who founded the organization.
The charter tells the organization to promote respect for human rights,
And for fundamental freedoms,
Without distinction of race, sex, language, or religion.
It does not write the rights out.
A purpose is not a list.

On the twenty-fourth of October the charter came into force.
The five permanent members had ratified,
And enough of the others.
The date is the organization's own day.
The articles of a right were still not in it.

The commission that was to draft them met after that.
{{c|4399|Eleanor Roosevelt}} was its chair.
{{c|4400|John Humphrey}}, of the secretariat, brought the first full draft.
{{c|4401|René Cassin}} set an order on that draft.
The text is not one hand.
{{c|4402|Peng Chun Chang}} asked that the first article hold conscience
As well as reason.
He brought the {{x|Chinese}} word ren to the argument,
The regard of one person for another.
The {{x|English}} that stayed beside reason is conscience.
{{c|4403|Hansa Mehta}} required the article to say human beings.
A draft had said men.
The article does not say men.

On the tenth of December, 1948, at the {{p|Palais de Chaillot}} in {{p|Paris}},
Before midnight, the {{x|General Assembly}} adopted the declaration.
The resolution is 217.
The declaration is its first part.
Thirty articles.
The first says that human beings are born free
And equal in dignity and in rights.
It says they are endowed with reason and with conscience,
And that they should act toward one another in a spirit of brotherhood.
One article says a person may change belief.
The preamble says that contempt for these rights
Has resulted in barbarous acts
Which have outraged the conscience of mankind.
It does not name the camps.
It does not name the cities.
The list of the dead is not this text.

Fifty-eight states were members.
Forty-eight voted for the declaration.
None voted against it.
Eight abstained.
The {{p|Soviet Union}} abstained,
And {{p|Ukraine}}, and {{p|Belarus}}, and {{p|Poland}},
And {{p|Czechoslovakia}}, and {{p|Yugoslavia}}.
{{p|Saudi Arabia}} abstained.
It had spoken against the article that lets a person change belief.
{{p|South Africa}} abstained.
{{p|Honduras}} was not in the vote.
{{p|Yemen}} was not in the vote.
Do not call the night unanimous.
A vote with eight abstentions and two absent
Is not a vote of every member.

{{c|4404|Andrei Vyshinsky}} spoke before the count.
He said a right had its meaning inside a state.
He asked the assembly to wait until the next year.
The motion to wait was lost, forty-five to six.
The assembly did not wait.

The declaration is not a treaty.
A state was not bound by signing it, because no one signed it.
The assembly adopted it.
The text that would bind a state which accepted the obligation
Was left to be written afterward.
Do not move that later text back into this night.
Do not make the preamble a register of the dead.
Do not make the charter's clause into the thirty articles.
The charter named a respect.
The declaration named articles.
They are two documents, and two years.

Hold the June signing, fifty hands, {{p|Poland}} not yet among them.
Hold the October day, when the charter had force and still no list.
Hold the tenth of December, before midnight.
Forty-eight for. None against. Eight withholding.
The word in the first article is human beings.
The word {{c|4405|Chang}} asked for is in the sentence.
A declaration can put a person on a page with every other person.
It does not, by being adopted, keep the person alive.
It does not close a shrine.
It does not choose a city.
The striving is to say the right where a state can hear it,
And not to pretend the hearing was a statute,
And not to pretend the silence of eight was a yes.

Count the charter on the twenty-sixth of June.
Count its force on the twenty-fourth of October.
Count the declaration before midnight on the tenth of December.
The articles are not the dead.
The dead are not thereby left off the work of naming.


# Chapter 320: The Recommendation

On the twenty-ninth of November, 1947, in {{p|New York}},
The {{x|General Assembly}} voted.
{{x|Resolution 181}} recommended a partition of the mandate of {{p|Palestine}}.
Thirty-three voted for it.
Thirteen voted against it.
Ten abstained.
One was absent.
The {{p|United States}} voted for it.
The {{p|Soviet Union}} voted for it.
{{p|Britain}}, the power that held the mandate, abstained.
The plan was an {{x|Arab}} state, a {{x|Jewish}} state,
And {{p|Jerusalem}} as a corpus separatum,
A city under an international regime,
Not the capital of either.
The mandate was to end not later than the first of August, 1948.
The two states, and the city, not later than the first of October.
The resolution says recommends.
A recommendation is not a government.
The people of the country did not cast these votes.

The {{x|Jewish Agency}} accepted the plan.
The {{x|Arab Higher Committee}} rejected it.
The states that voted no had said no with their names.
Between the vote and the spring there was already fighting.
The declaration did not begin it.

{{p|Britain}} did not stay until the plan's last date.
At midnight, the night of the fourteenth of May, 1948,
The mandate ended.
That afternoon, at four, in the museum in {{p|Tel Aviv}},
{{c|4406|David Ben-Gurion}} read a scroll.
It declared a {{x|Jewish}} state, to be called {{p|Israel}},
From the moment the mandate ended that night.
It claimed a natural and historic right,
And the strength of the {{x|Assembly}}'s resolution.
The scroll does not draw the plan's borders as its own.
It says the state will keep complete equality
Of social and political rights
To all its inhabitants, irrespective of religion, race, or sex.
It says it will safeguard the holy places of all religions.
It says it will be faithful to the principles of the {{x|Charter}}.
The closing words put trust in the {{c|4407|Rock of Israel}}.
The words can be heard as God.
The words can be heard as the people.
The text does not say which.

The {{x|Arab}} state in the plan was not declared.
On the fifteenth the armies entered:
{{p|Egypt}}, {{p|Transjordan}}, {{p|Syria}}, {{p|Lebanon}}, and {{p|Iraq}}.
{{p|Transjordan}} is the name that state then used.
{{p|Jerusalem}} was not set up as the separated city.
The fighting divided it.
The international regime was not established.

People left their houses.
People were driven from their houses.
About seven hundred thousand, by the count of the {{x|United Nations}}.{{fn|The United Nations Conciliation Commission estimated about 711,000 refugees in 1951. Other estimates run from about 520,000 to 900,000.}}
Neither fact cancels the other.
A village is not the whole, and the whole is not a village.
The {{p|United States}} recognized the state that day,
De facto.
Recognition is not the map.

Do not say the recommendation was the country.
The {{x|Assembly}} drew three regimes on one land.
What the year did was one declaration, a war,
And a city that was not international.
Do not say the scroll's equality is a report of the year.
It is a charge the state wrote down for itself.
A charge is not kept by being written.
Do not say the war was the only answer the vote could have had.
Do not say the vote was nothing because a war followed.
The {{x|Agency}} said yes. The {{x|Committee}} said no.
Those were decisions. Other decisions were open,
And were not taken.

Hold the three lines the plan drew,
And the one state the scroll declared,
And the houses the year emptied, by leaving and by driving.
Refuse the consolation that a resolution is a birth,
And the consolation that a birth erases the resolution's other state.
The striving named in the scroll is equality,
And the holy places of all religions, kept.
The year did not accomplish the sentence.
The sentence remains a sentence.
Count the vote on the twenty-ninth of November.
Count the scroll on the fourteenth of May.
The map of the plan and the map of the fighting
Are not the same map.


# Chapter 321: The Suggested Copy

On the twenty-fifth of April, 1953, the journal {{x|Nature}}
Printed three papers on one substance.
The substance is deoxyribose nucleic acid.
The initials are DNA.
The first paper is from {{p|Cambridge}}.
{{c|4408|James Watson}} and {{c|4409|Francis Crick}} wrote it.
They wish to suggest a structure.
Two chains, wound together.
The bases pair.
Adenine fits thymine.
Guanine fits cytosine.
The paper says it has not escaped their notice
That the pairing they have postulated
Immediately suggests a possible copying mechanism
For the genetic material.
They say the suggestion was stimulated
By the unpublished results and ideas
Of workers in {{p|London}}.
A suggestion is not a measurement they made.
It begins on one page and ends on the next.

The other two papers are from {{p|King's College}}, {{p|London}}.
{{c|4410|Maurice Wilkins}} and his colleagues signed one.
{{c|4411|Rosalind Franklin}} and {{c|4412|Raymond Gosling}} signed the other.
Their photograph of the salt, taken in 1952,
Is in that issue under their names.
{{c|4413|Franklin}} had measured a helix.
She had the phosphates on the outside
And the bases toward the middle.
She had not signed the {{p|Cambridge}} page.
Do not say she failed to see her own photograph.
The claim that she missed it is a later telling.
The journal of that April prints her name
On the evidence.

In 1968 {{c|4414|Watson}} published a book.
He wrote that {{c|4415|Wilkins}} showed him the photograph
In the first months of 1953,
And that his pulse raced.
The book is his account, fifteen years on.
It is not the issue of the journal.
The book speaks of her in a way the April page does not.
Take the page.

Five weeks later, on the thirtieth of May,
{{c|4414|Watson}} and {{c|4416|Crick}} published the genetical implications.
The April sentence had already said the pairing suggests a copy.

This was not the discovery of the substance.
The substance had a name long before.
In 1944 {{c|4417|Oswald Avery}}, with {{c|4418|Colin MacLeod}}
And {{c|4419|Maclyn McCarty}}, had shown that a substance
Which changed what a bacterium would be
Was this acid, and not a protein.
The year before the April papers,
{{c|4420|Alfred Hershey}} and {{c|4421|Martha Chase}}
Had argued that what a virus puts into a bacterium,
The part that carries the change, is the acid
And not the coat.
The April page is a structure.
It is not the first news that the acid can carry a heredity.

{{c|4422|Erwin Chargaff}} had weighed the bases.
Adenine matched thymine.
Guanine matched cytosine.
The model uses that match.
He did not sign the April papers.
Earlier in 1953 {{c|4423|Linus Pauling}} had published a structure
Of three chains.
It did not hold.
The {{p|Cambridge}} page says its own structure is another.

In 1962 the prize in physiology or medicine
Went to {{c|4414|Watson}}, to {{c|4416|Crick}}, and to {{c|4415|Wilkins}}.
{{c|4413|Franklin}} had died in 1958.
The prize is not given to the dead.
Her name is on the April page.
The prize's list is not that page.
Do not move the prize back into the month of the papers.
Do not make the later book the judge of what she measured.

A pairing is a finite means.
One chain can set the bases of the next.
The setting is a copy, if the fit holds.
The fit does not say whether the copy should be made.
The fit does not say what the copy is for.
Do not make the page into a verdict on a life.
Do not make the copying into a permission.
The paper says suggests.
It says possible.
Hold those two words.
They are the paper's own care.

Count the twenty-fifth of April.
Count three papers, and whose name is on each.
Count the thirtieth of May as the implications,
Not as the first sentence.
The substance was already known to carry a change.
The new sentence is the shape, and the copy the shape allows.
A shape is not a commandment.
The dead of the prize's year are not this chapter.
{{c|4413|Franklin}}'s measurement is.


# Chapter 322: The Published Frequency

On the fourth of October, 1957, at twenty-eight minutes
And thirty-four seconds past seven in the evening,
By the time kept at {{p|Greenwich}},
A sphere left a pad at {{p|Tyuratam}}.
By the clock in {{p|Moscow}} it was twenty-eight minutes
And thirty-four seconds past ten at night.
At the pad it was twenty-eight minutes
And thirty-four seconds past midnight,
And the date was the fifth.
Do not collapse the three clocks into one day.
The world dates the launch on the fourth.

The pad is in what is now {{p|Kazakhstan}}.
The site is now called {{p|Baikonur}}.
The town of that name is not the pad.
Do not say the sphere left from the town.

The sphere was the simplest satellite.
The word in the announcement is the word for a satellite.
The name that stayed is {{x|Sputnik}}.
It was fifty-eight centimeters across.
It weighed 83.6 kilograms.
Four antennas stood out from it.
Thirty-six bolts joined the shell.
Nitrogen was sealed inside.
These are the object's measures.
They are not a meaning.

The rocket was a form of the {{x|R-7}}.
That form had been made to carry a warhead
From one continent to another.
In August of that year a rocket of this form
Had already completed a flight, with no satellite on it.
This one carried a sphere.
The sphere was not a bomb.
Do not make the orbit into a proof
That a weapon had been justified.
Do not make the sphere into the weapon.

{{c|4424|Sergei Korolev}} directed the work.
The state did not publish his name.
The frequency was published.
Hold those two acts.
They are not the same kind of secrecy.

The sphere transmitted on 20.005
And on 40.002.
A beep, and a beep.
A radio that could reach those numbers
Could hear that the sphere was passing.
The beep is not a speech.
It says the body is there.
It does not say why the body was sent.

That night the agency announced
That a satellite was in orbit.
A circuit takes about ninety-six minutes.
The announcement is not the beep.

The batteries lasted until the twenty-sixth of October.
On the fourth of January, 1958, the sphere came down.
It burned. It was not recovered.

On the third of November a second satellite
Left the same pad.
It carried a dog. Her name was {{c|4425|Laika}}.
There was no way prepared to bring her down.
The report said she lived for days.
In 2002 {{c|4426|Dimitri Malashenkov}} said the heat
Had killed her within hours,
By the fourth circuit.
Do not repeat the report that she lived for days.
Do not describe the cabin.
She was sent, and she was not brought back.
The seventh of November was the anniversary
They were writing toward.
The dog went up on the third.
An anniversary is not a reason that answers for her.

This day of the book keeps a rite on the fifteenth of November,
In the count {{p|Japan}} uses.
The rite is {{x|Shichi-go-san}}.
Seven, five, and three.
It is not a holiday of the state.
A household may go on the day, or on a day near it.

At three the child's hair was let grow.
That rite was kept for girls and for boys.
At five a boy was dressed in hakama,
The formal trousers.
At seven a girl took the wide sash.
The visit to a shrine, as households keep it,
Spread in the {{x|Meiji}} years.
The tradition says the shogun {{c|4427|Tokugawa Tsunayoshi}} fixed the fifteenth for his son,
And this book keeps the tradition.

The child is taken to a shrine.
Thanks are given that the child has lived.
The wish is that the child go on living.
The candy is called a thousand years.
It is red and white.
The candy is not a contract.

Do not say the children were brought
Because a sphere was in the sky.
The year of the launch is 1957.
The rite is older than the year.
The calendar of this book puts them on one day.
Count both. Do not make them one cause.

A frequency can say that a body is passing.
The body should have been sent: going to space is part of life's purpose.
A count of three ages can say a child has lived this far.
The child is wished a thousand years, and the wish is a prayer of life.
The rocket was built for a warhead.
The night it flew, it carried a sphere that beeped.
The beep is a finite means.
The rite is a finite thanks.
Neither one is a permission.
Neither one is the sky's purpose.

Count the fourth of October by the world's clock,
And the fifth at the pad.
Count the name that was withheld
And the two numbers that were not.
Count the dog, and the hours, not the days.
Count seven, five, and three.
The sphere came down.
The rite is still kept.


# Chapter 323: The Mother Tongue

On the eleventh of October, 1962,
In the basilica of {{c|4428|Saint Peter}}, in {{p|Vatican City}},
{{c|4429|John XXIII}} opened a council.
He had said, on the twenty-fifth of January, 1959,
In {{p|Rome}}, to the cardinals gathered in the house
Beside the basilica of {{p|Saint Paul Outside the Walls}},
That a council would be called,
And a synod for the city,
And a bringing up to date of the code of the law.
The word on the code was aggiornamento.
It means a bringing up to date.
It was not the name of the council.

The first session closed on the eighth of December.
He died on the third of June, 1963, in {{p|Rome}}.
The council was between its sessions.
He did not promulgate the constitution on the rite.

{{c|4430|Paul VI}} was elected on the twenty-first of June.
The second session ran from the twenty-ninth of September
To the fourth of December, 1963.
On that day he promulgated the constitution
On the sacred liturgy.
Its name is {{x|Sacrosanctum Concilium}}.

Particular law remaining in force,
The use of {{x|Latin}} is to be preserved in the {{x|Latin}} rites.
Since the mother tongue, in the {{x|Mass}},
In the sacraments, and in the other parts,
May often be of great advantage to the people,
The limits of its use may be extended.
In the first place, the readings and the directives,
And some of the prayers and the chants.

In Masses celebrated with the people,
A suitable place may be allotted to their mother tongue.
First, the readings and the common prayer.
Also, as the place warrants,
The parts that pertain to the people.
Steps are to be taken so that the same people
May also say, or sing, in {{x|Latin}},
The parts of the ordinary that are theirs.
A use wider than that follows a further article.
It is not taken by the parish.

The competent territorial authority decides the extent.
The {{x|Apostolic See}} confirms the decision.
A translation into the mother tongue
Is made from the {{x|Latin}} text,
And that authority approves it.
No other person, even a priest,
May add, or remove, or change anything in the rite
On his own authority.

The practical norms are for the {{x|Roman rite}}.
The other rites, lawfully acknowledged,
Are held of equal right and dignity,
And are to be preserved.
Particular law had already excepted some places.
The constitution keeps the exception.
The {{x|Kyrie}} of the {{x|Mass}} was already {{x|Greek}}.

On the twenty-sixth of September, 1964,
An instruction carried the constitution toward the Sunday.
The {{x|Consilium}} prepared it, by mandate of {{c|4430|Paul VI}}.
{{c|4431|Giacomo Lercaro}} presented it.
{{c|4430|Paul VI}} confirmed it in an audience
Given to {{c|4432|Arcadio Maria Larraona}},
Prefect of the {{x|Congregation of Rites}},
And ordered it observed from the seventh of March, 1965,
The first Sunday of {{x|Lent}}.

For a {{x|Mass}} with a congregation,
Once the {{x|Holy See}} has confirmed the decision,
The people's language may be used
For the lessons, the epistle, and the gospel,
For the prayer of the faithful,
For the chants of the ordinary,
The {{x|Kyrie}}, the {{x|Gloria}}, the creed,
The {{x|Sanctus}}, and the {{x|Agnus Dei}},
For the introit, the offertory, and the communion,
For the chants between the readings,
For the greetings and the dialogues,
For the words at the people's communion,
And for the {{x|Lord's Prayer}},
With its introduction and the short prayer after it.
The book at the rite keeps the {{x|Latin}} text beside the other.
The pastors are charged to see
That the people can still say, or sing, in {{x|Latin}},
The parts of the ordinary that are theirs.

The parts the priest sings or says alone
Are not on that list.
The {{x|Holy See}} alone can permit those.
Do not say the whole {{x|Mass}} changed its tongue
On the seventh of March.
Do not say the instruction took the priest's own prayer
Out of {{x|Latin}}.

The council closed on the eighth of December, 1965.
The constitution was not a new book of the {{x|Mass}}.
A later book is not moved back into these years.

Do not say the council silenced {{x|Latin}}.
The page that opens the mother tongue
Says that {{x|Latin}} is to be preserved.
Do not say the people were left outside the words.
The constitution says they are not to be there
As strangers, or as silent spectators.
That sentence is a charge.
It is not a report of every parish.
Conscious participation, active participation,
Is called their right and their duty, by baptism.
Hearing a reading is not the whole of the charge.
It is the part the years in this chapter actually opened.

A permission is not yet a Sunday.
Hold the two sentences on the one page.
The striving is that the people understand the rite
And take their part in it,
In a tongue they are given, and in the {{x|Latin}}
The page refused to discard.
Count the constitution on the fourth of December.
Count the instruction on the seventh of March.
In these years the tongue of the reading
And the tongue of the prayer the priest said alone
Were not the same tongue.


# Chapter 324: The Master in the Mountain

The filming did not begin in the year of the vault.
In 1938 the {{x|Genealogical Society of Utah}}
Began to copy books onto rolls of film.
The vault is where the masters were put.
It is not the first camera.

The place is {{p|Little Cottonwood Canyon}},
In the {{p|Wasatch}}, in {{p|Utah}},
About a mile up from the mouth,
About twenty miles southeast of {{p|Salt Lake City}}.
The room is cut into the north wall.
The published depth is about six hundred feet.
Seven hundred feet of granite stand over the rooms.
A depth and a cover are not the same measure.

The stone is called granite.
The rock is quartz monzonite.
It is the stone of the temple in the city.
The temple's blocks were split from boulders
At the mouth of the canyon.
The workers' account is that explosives
Were not used on those blocks.
The temple was dedicated in 1893.
The vault was blasted into the wall.
The quarry and the vault are not the same cut.

In the late years of the 1950s the site was tested.
Blasting began in May 1960.
In April 1963 the first rolls were carried in.
The construction was not finished
Until December of that year.
In that December visitors were taken through.
Do not say the mountain was never shown.
The showing is not a reading room.

The published cost was two million dollars.
The main door weighs fourteen tons, and the two smaller doors nine tons each,
Built to stand against a blast.

A laboratory sits under the overhang.
The storage is deeper in.
Six vaults hold the film, off the corridors cut into the granite.

In 1965 the vault was in operation.
It was named in May 1966.
It was dedicated on the twenty-second of June, 1966.
Do not say the whole of it was built in 1965.
1965 is the year the work was going.
The dedication is the next year.

The owner is the {{x|Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints}}.
The society that sent the cameras
Is the {{x|Genealogical Society of Utah}}.
Where an archive agreed, a camera copied the books.
The camera does not take the book.
The book stays where it was.
The film is a copy of the page
As the page was on the day of the filming.

The master roll stays in the mountain.
A person who comes to read
Comes to a copy, elsewhere.
The vault is not that room.

The names are kept so that the living
Can ask a rite for the dead.
The rite named here is a baptism,
Done by a living person, in a temple,
In the name of someone who has died.
The rite is not done in the mountain.
The mountain keeps the name.
The church teaches that the dead
May accept what was asked, or refuse it.
That is the teaching.
It is not a report of any one dead person.
The film does not perform the rite.
The film does not obtain the answer.

Do not say every person who has died
Is in the mountain.
The rolls are the books the cameras reached.
A name not filmed is not invented here.
A later copying onto disks,
And a site on the network,
Are not this year.
Do not move them back.

A film outlives the book, if the book burns:
That is a real keeping. And the old fight
Comes with it, ours, the one that returns:
Who may honour which dead, and by what right.

Some say: our dead are ours, and leave them be.
The rite: a gift the dead may take or leave,
Offered in the temple, and offered free;
And no name lost: the thing this book would weave.

Count 1938 as the start of the filming.
Count May 1960 as the start of the blasting.
Count April 1963 as the first rolls,
And December 1963 as the showing.
Count 1965 as the year of the operation.
Count the twenty-second of June, 1966, as the dedication.
The master stays.
The book stays in its archive.
The question the rite asks
Is not answered by the stone.


# Chapter 325: Left as a Museum

On the sixteenth of May, 1966,
A circular went out inside the party, in {{p|Beijing}}.
It was called a notification.
The name that stayed is the {{x|Cultural Revolution}}.
The country was not given the text that day.
{{x|People's Daily}} printed it a year later,
On the seventeenth of May, 1967.
A circular inside a party is not a vote of the people.

On the eighth of August the {{x|Central Committee}} adopted
A decision on that revolution, in sixteen points.
The decision is not a catalog of what to break.

On the first of June the same newspaper had printed four names:
Old ideas, old culture, old customs, old habits.
Which object was old was not written down.
On the eighteenth of August, at the gate in {{p|Beijing}},
{{c|4433|Mao Zedong}} received the {{c|4434|Red Guards}}.
He wore an army coat.
{{c|4435|Lin Biao}} told the crowd to smash the four.
A million filled the square.
In the days after, the breaking began in the city.
Do not say the four names were a law with edges.
Do not say a name in a newspaper is a stone already fallen.

Temples were broken. Books were burned.
Tablets were smashed. Graves were opened.
People were beaten. People were killed.
Across the country a million and a half died in those years, by the common count.
Some objects were hidden.
A hidden book does not put a hall back.
A hall still standing does not close a grave.
A person is not the label the month set on them.
The {{c|4434|Red Guards}} were students.
They were not the whole of the country.

In {{p|Qufu}} the temple, the mansion, and the cemetery
Of {{c|1958|Confucius}} stood under a protection of the state.
In August the hands charged with the three places
Did not give them up.
Early in November a group came from {{p|Beijing}},
Led by {{c|4436|Tan Houlan}}, of {{p|Beijing Normal University}}.
On the twelfth, later accounts give the word
From {{c|4437|Chen Boda}} and {{c|4438|Qi Benyu}} as three charges.
Do not destroy the mansion, the temple, or the cemetery.
Leave them as a museum.
The grave may be dug.
Those were the three charges.

On the fifteenth the stones that marked the protection
Were broken at a rally.
In the last days of November the grave was dug.
The diggers broke open the tombs of the house of {{c|4439|Kong}}.
Books were burned by the cartload,
And six thousand relics were destroyed.
Some things were hidden by the people of the place.
The clay of a statue is not the rite.
The rite is not kept by calling the clay only clay.
The grave of the man whose work was the keeping of rites
Was opened under an order that the buildings were to stand.

The quarrel was our own: who keeps the dead,
The house of {{c|4439|Kong}}, or those who came to break;
Who holds the rite, the grave, the tablet's bread.
They kept a museum, for the walls' sake;

A museum is not a sacrifice.
The rite was ours, and the rite paid the price.
Some books were hidden by the people there;
Our fathers' tablets ask for that same care.

{{c|4433|Mao Zedong}} died on the ninth of September, 1976,
In {{p|Beijing}}.
On the sixth of October {{c|4440|Hua Guofeng}} had four people arrested:
{{c|4441|Jiang Qing}}, {{c|4442|Zhang Chunqiao}},
{{c|4443|Yao Wenyuan}}, {{c|4444|Wang Hongwen}}.
The name given afterward is the {{c|4445|Gang of Four}}.
The arrest is the end the later telling uses.
It did not fill the grave.
A judgment written in a later year
Is not moved back into this October.

Hold the circular, and the four names,
And the order that kept a museum and allowed a grave,
And the books that were burned, and the books that were hidden.
Refuse the consolation that a slogan restores a rite,
And the consolation that a broken hall is the whole of a people.
Count the circular on the sixteenth of May.
Count the grave in the last days of November.
The name of a tradition and the stone of a grave
Are not the same thing.
The year struck at both.


# Chapter 326: The Eagle and the Two Letters

On the sixteenth of July, 1969,
{{c|4446|Neil Armstrong}}, {{c|4447|Buzz Aldrin}}, and {{c|4448|Michael Collins}}
Left the cape then called {{p|Cape Kennedy}}.
The cape is now {{p|Cape Canaveral}}.
The center is the {{p|Kennedy Space Center}}.
Do not collapse the names.
A person had already left the {{p|Earth}} in the spring of 1961.
On the twenty-fifth of May, 1961,
{{c|4449|John Kennedy}} had asked for a landing and a return
Before the decade was out.

On the twentieth of July the lander, called the {{x|Eagle}},
Set down on the {{p|Sea of Tranquility}}.
By the {{p|Greenwich}} clock it was seventeen minutes past eight
In the evening.
In the east of the {{p|United States}}
It was seventeen minutes past four in the afternoon.
The landing is the twentieth on both clocks.
{{c|4446|Neil Armstrong}} said: {{p|Houston}}, {{p|Tranquility Base}} here.
The {{x|Eagle}} has landed.
{{c|4448|Michael Collins}} stayed in the ship called {{x|Columbia}},
In orbit, so the two could come back.
He did not walk.
Do not say three men walked.

The step was later.
By the clocks of the {{p|United States}}
It was still the twentieth, about four minutes before eleven
At night, in the east.
By the {{p|Greenwich}} clock it was four minutes before three
In the morning of the twenty-first.
Do not collapse the two dates.

He spoke of a small step, and of a giant leap for mankind.
He meant one small step for a man,
And the little word was lost in the static, and the meaning was not.

Before the step, {{c|4447|Buzz Aldrin}} asked, on the open line,
For a pause, and for each listener to give thanks
In that listener's own way.
In the pause he took bread and wine he had brought.
The card he had carried said he was the vine
And the hearers the branches.
He did not speak the bread and the wine on the open line.
A thanks asked of every listener
Is not the same act as a rite kept beside the radio.

A machine had struck the {{p|Moon}} in 1959.
A machine had set down and sent pictures back in 1966.
In December 1968 three people had gone around the {{p|Moon}}
And come back. They had not landed.
Do not say a boot was the first thing to touch.
The first in this chapter is the first people to step out
And stand, and the first to leave again alive.

The plaque on the leg of the lander says
That men from the {{p|Earth}} first set foot upon the {{p|Moon}},
In July 1969.
It does not give the day.
It says they came in peace for all mankind.
The year was also a contest between states.
The peace is what the plaque says.
It is not a report that the year was peace.
A rod held the flag out.
There is no wind there to move a cloth.
Do not make the photograph a fraud.
Do not make the rod a wind.

They were on the ground for about twenty-one hours and a half.
The walk was about two hours and a half.
They left the ground on the twenty-first, by both clocks.
On the twenty-fourth of July they came down in the {{p|Pacific}}.
The ship that took them aboard was the {{x|Hornet}}.

On the twenty-ninth of October, at half past ten at night,
In {{p|Los Angeles}}, a line was opened
To {{p|Menlo Park}}.
{{c|4450|Charley Kline}} typed, in the laboratory of {{c|4451|Leonard Kleinrock}}.
{{c|4452|Bill Duvall}} was at the far end,
At the {{x|Stanford Research Institute}}.
The word they meant to send was login.
The first try carried L, and O, and stopped.
The log they kept is those two letters.
A further try went through.
Do not say the first message was the whole word.
Do not say the path stayed shut.

Two more laboratories were in the plan,
At {{p|Santa Barbara}} and in {{p|Utah}}.
On the twenty-ninth the link was the one link.
Before the year was out the four were joined.
The money was a defense agency's.
The hands that night were at two laboratories.
Do not make the two letters a weapon.
Do not make them innocent of the office that paid.
A message can be cut into pieces.
The pieces can take more than one path.
The far end can put them back.
That is a finite means.
Two letters are not yet a people talking.
The web people later used is not this October.
Do not move it back.

This day of the book keeps the {{x|Thanksgiving}}
Of the {{p|United States}}.
The landing was in July.
The two letters were in October.
In 1969 the Thursday kept for the meal
Was the twenty-seventh of November.
None of the three is the others' day.

A harvest was eaten in 1621, at {{p|Plymouth}},
By the {{c|3244|English}} there and by the {{c|3547|Wampanoag}}.
That table was not a national holiday.
In 1863 {{c|4453|Abraham Lincoln}} proclaimed a national day,
The last Thursday of November, in a war.
In 1941 the law fixed the fourth Thursday.
Do not say the nation began at the table in 1621.
Do not say the table was nothing.
The thanks {{c|4447|Buzz Aldrin}} asked for, in July,
Was not this Thursday.
A thanks is not a landing.
A landing is not a thanks.

Count the twentieth for the landing on both clocks.
Count the step on the twentieth in the country
And on the twenty-first at {{p|Greenwich}}.
Count the two letters on the twenty-ninth of October.
Count the Thursday of the meal on its own day.
The {{x|Eagle}} came back.
The two letters were only a beginning.
A path opened is not yet a reason.
The reason is what the people do with the path,
And what they refuse to call a peace
When the plaque has said the word
And the year has not finished saying it.


# Chapter 327: As Far as a New Time

On the twentieth of April, 1972,
The first day of summer that year,
A meeting at a hotel called the {{p|Borg}},
In {{p|Reykjavík}}, formed a fellowship.
The name of it was Ásatrúarfélagið.
A later account also names the thirtieth.
Do not make the two meetings one meeting.
They were not a church that day.
The poems were already old. The meeting was new.

{{c|4454|Sveinbjörn Beinteinsson}} was a sheep farmer
In {{p|Borgarfjörður}}, and a singer of rímur.
Soon after, they gave him the title allsherjargoði,
The word that had named the goði
Who hallowed the assembly.
The word was used again. The office was not.
Do not say a medieval law had been waiting
On a farm.

In the first letter to the ministry
They named the old religion of the {{c|4455|Icelanders}},
Law until the year 1000, so far as it fitted
A new time and changed conditions.
A paper that spring called them
The Ásatrú people of the new time.
They said nýheiðni: new heathenry.
Do not say they claimed an unbroken priesthood.
The limit is in the application.

Near the year one thousand, the tellings say,
{{p|Þingvellir}}: one house chose the public way,
The {{x|Christian}} law, for all, would hold the sway;
A private sacrifice was still permitted,
And then that permission was taken back.
A book is not a blót.
A blót in 1973 is not that assembly's law.
Do not say the gods ended in a day,
Or that a public sacrifice had never stopped.

Shortly before {{x|Christmas}}, 1972,
{{c|4454|Sveinbjörn Beinteinsson}} and {{c|4456|Þorsteinn Guðjónsson}}
Went to {{c|4457|Ólafur Jóhannesson}},
Minister of justice and of ecclesiastical affairs.
He thought the request was a joke.
They said they were serious, and he asked for papers.
By {{c|4458|Sveinbjörn}}'s account, after they had left,
The lights went out in the center of {{p|Reykjavík}}.
On the second of January a paper made a joke of it,
And gave the thunder to {{c|4459|Þór}}.
The letter was not that night. A storm is not a signature.

{{c|4460|Sigurbjörn Einarsson}}, bishop of {{p|Iceland}},
Wrote against it. The opinion is dated
The second of January, 1973.
He read the right to found organizations to serve god
As a phrase for one god.
He wrote that the teachings were not fixed,
And that there was no house for the rite.
He named {{p|Germany}}, and a racial use of the old gods.
He wrote that the group was twenty-one.
An earlier letter had said about a hundred.
And the roll has grown every year since.

The applicants denied that the fellowship
Was national socialism.
They wrote that a genuine following of these gods
In that {{p|Reich}} was doubtful, and that some Christian bodies
Had gone along with it.
A denial is not a proof. The bishop's fear is not the fellowship.
Do not try them as the {{p|Germany}} he named,
And do not call the denial the end of the question.

The first papers did not meet the rules.
Later papers did, and the ministry said so.
On the third of May, 1973, a letter came
To a house on {{p|Ingólfsstræti}}, in {{p|Reykjavík}},
And confirmed him as the legal head.
The papers reported it on the fifteenth.
Do not collapse the third and the fifteenth.
On the sixteenth, twenty-one people were in the room.
Attendance is not the roll.

What May gave was a registered society.
The national church stayed the national church,
The {{x|Evangelical Lutheran Church}}.
What the register carried were acts that church counted:
A naming, a coming of age, a marriage, a burial.
The rights come because the priests have them.
Do not say the old goði's work was copied
Line for line into the letter.
A share of the church tax followed
The adult members on the list.
A name on a list draws a share.
A share is not a belief.
It was a fight in one house, for the share,
The register, the rite, whose priests were there.

Later that year {{c|4461|Halldór Blöndal}}
And {{c|4462|Magnús Jónsson}} asked the minister why.
{{c|4462|Magnús Jónsson}} said the freedom was for one god,
And that a polytheism, and idol worship,
Were not a lawful recognition.
The minister answered with the freedom of association
And the freedom of religion, and said the scholars
Had not agreed how far the clause reached.
It reached far enough: the old gods were recognized.

On the fifth of August, at {{p|Dragháls}},
They held a blót in the rain, under a plaster figure
Of {{c|4459|Þór}} that {{c|4463|Jörmundur Ingi Hansen}} had made.
A May headline had said nine hundred years.
The years since the assembly's law are not nine hundred.
The August telling called the day the first public
Outdoor blót since the ban.
Do not use either sentence as a count of the silence.
A bird was killed in the kitchen while a lamb was cooked.
The farmer said the meat was bought,
Because a killing inside the rite was more trouble
Than it was worth. One account has both.
Do not make the kitchen the theology, and do not leave the bird out.

The return was not only in {{p|Iceland}}.
A brotherhood in the {{p|United States}}
Had a tax exemption in 1972.
In {{p|Britain}} a body called the {{x|Pagan Front}}
Had been named by 1971.
Neither one is this letter.
A later use of these names kept them for a descent.
Do not move that use back into this May,
And do not pretend the bishop had not asked.
In 1975 the assembly made the next recognition harder.
Do not move that change back into May.

Count the twentieth of April, 1972, as the meeting
On the first day of summer, and the thirtieth
As the other account.
Count the third of May, 1973, as the letter,
And the fifteenth as the papers.
Count the fifth of August as the blót in the rain.
The poems are old. The hotel is new.
The letter is a registration.
They asked for the old law only as far
As a new time would bear it.
That limit is the striving.
A list can hold a name. It cannot hold the years since the assembly,
And it cannot make those years nothing.


# Chapter 328: As of 1979

From the eighteenth to the twenty-second of December, 1978,
The {{x|Central Committee}} sat in {{p|Beijing}}.
It was the third session of the eleventh committee.
{{c|4440|Hua Guofeng}} presided.
He was the chairman.
The session did not remove him.
{{c|4464|Deng Xiaoping}} was a vice-chairman.
On the thirteenth, five days before the session opened,
At the close of the working conference, he spoke.
The speech asks for the mind to be unbound,
For truth to be sought from facts,
And for unity in looking to the future.
The speech is not the communique.

The communique was adopted on the twenty-second.
It said the large movement to expose and criticize
{{c|4435|Lin Biao}} and the gang of four
Had in the main been completed,
And it said victoriously.
The word is the communique's.
It is not a count of any grave.
It said the stress of the party's work
Would shift to socialist modernization,
As of 1979.
A shift of the work is not a resignation of the party.
The session was not a vote of the country.
Do not say the chairman's title passed that week.
A later telling calls {{c|4464|Deng Xiaoping}} the leader from this session.
The titles in the communique are the titles of that week.
A later change of chairman is not this December.

On the fifteenth of December, in {{p|Washington}},
And on the sixteenth, in {{p|Beijing}},
The two states announced
That relations would begin on the first of January.
Do not collapse the two dates of the announcement.
On the twenty-ninth of January, 1979,
{{c|4464|Deng Xiaoping}} was received in {{p|Washington}},
As vice premier.
{{c|4465|Jimmy Carter}} welcomed him.
On the thirty-first they signed agreements
On science, and on culture.
A communique dated the official visit through the fourth of February.
He left {{p|Seattle}} on the morning of the fifth.
The visit is not the day the relations began.
An agreement on a science is not a constitution.
Do not say one sentence opened a market.
Do not say the work was only a new name.
The work was turned toward modernization.
The chairman stayed.

On the sixteenth of January, 1979,
{{c|4466|Mohammad Reza Pahlavi}} left {{p|Tehran}}.
No abdication was signed.
{{c|4467|Shapour Bakhtiar}} remained the prime minister.
On the first of February {{c|4468|Ruhollah Khomeini}} landed
At the airport in the city,
At half past nine in the morning, by that city's clock.
The aircraft was a chartered plane of {{x|Air France}}.
It had left {{p|Paris}}.
He had been in exile fifteen years.
Millions came to meet him.
He spoke at the airport.
He went to the cemetery of {{p|Behesht-e Zahra}},
